find_cheapest_time.description: Find when to run something that uses electricity for a set time, such as charging a car, a wash or a heat pump boost, so it falls in the cheapest stretch of day-ahead prices: the start time, how long to wait, the average price and how much it saves against the period's average. Searches from now unless you give an earliest start. No API key required.

description: Bring Denmark's open energy data from Energinet into a workflow: day-ahead electricity prices for DK1, DK2 and neighbouring areas every 15 minutes, the cheapest time to charge a car or run a wash, CO2 per kWh measured and forecast, where the power is coming from right now, and the wind and solar forecast. Every other dataset, from consumption to gas flows, can be queried too. No account or API key required.
